searchText: <inphi> What was the reason for changing the base intrinsic gas from 21000 to 20000? <protolambda> > <protolambda> It could encourage wider adoption, hopefully getting the majority of all users to use the same latest tx type. (the tx can have 0 blobs). Which offers fixed size tx fields/offsets, and merkleized contents. Can’t find rationale info in spec or website however. We should add that if we go for this change. And maybe I’m missing something. (re @inphi: What was the reason for changing the base intrinsic gas from 21000 to 20000?) We should not be using gas pricing as an incentivization tool. Gas prices should represent operational costs. There are a bunch of behaviors we would like to encourage/discourage, but we shouldn't hijack operational cost pricing to achieve that. If two operations have the same operational cost, then they should have the same gas price. <adietrichs> I’m with Micah there, but at the very least a controversial step like that should have clear justification in the EIP. Though, reading over the EIP it appears the proposal is to change `G_transaction` to `20000`, but this is only mentioned in passing in a comment in the specification so at best the specification is underspecified. If the intent is to change `G_transaction`, then that should be a separate EIP that includes justification just like every other gas cost change. <protolambda> Agreed, it's not critical to the EIP, happy to remove it. <inphi> thanks for the clarification. We should remove it then. +1 on removing https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5636
